label: Bing Flights Scraper
title: Bing Flights Scraper: Fares, Itineraries & Price Calendar
metaDescription: Search Bing Flights for itineraries with prices, airlines, stops and legs in 23 markets, plus Explore destinations and a day-by-day price calendar.
intro: Search Bing Flights for real itineraries with price, airlines, stops and every leg, in 23 country markets, so you can compare the same route across currencies. It also lists Explore destinations from any airport and a day-by-day price calendar.
useCases: Compare one route's price across markets and currencies
Find the cheapest days to fly with the price calendar
Feed fares into a travel-deals site or an alert

faq.q: Can I paste a Bing Flights link?
faq.a: Yes. Each link copied from bing.com/travel is one search, read exactly as Bing reads it (route, dates, one way or round trip, cabin, travellers). Or fill in one search with From, To and dates.

faq.q: Can I track a fare every day?
faq.a: Yes. Use a relative date such as "30 days" and schedule the run: each day it searches 30 days ahead, so you follow the same window over time.

faq.q: Does it give booking sites and prices?
faq.a: Yes. Turn on booking options to get the sellers on a flight's Bing booking page with price, rating, booking link, change rule and fare details.
Bing's "Book now / Wait" advice for the route, with its confidence, returned with the flights.
Yes. Leave To empty (or write Anywhere) for Bing's Explore: where you can fly from your airport, cheapest, quickest or most popular first. A price calendar for the next ~80 days is optional.

officialApi: Bing Flights has no public API. Flight price APIs from airlines and aggregators need partner contracts; this actor returns the prices Bing Flights shows, in 23 markets and their currencies.
